name: inherited-field
title: Inherited field
description: A setting that follows its parent until you override it: the inherited value shown and named, an Override switch, and Reset back to inherited.
docs: Pass the parent's value and who it comes from as inherited ({ value, source }), the person's own value as value (null while the setting follows the parent, which is also what onValueChange reports, so a form can send it as no value) and control, a function that renders your input from the value, onValueChange and the ids it is handed: spread them onto the input. The control is not rendered while the value is inherited, so a form never sends it. The Override switch starts the control from the inherited value, or from the value the person had before; Reset and the switch go back, and the typed value is remembered until the field unmounts, so key it after a save; a value equal to the inherited one is not worth remembering and is not (equals compares objects and arrays, default Object.is). format writes a value in words ("30 days"), description adds a line under the label, and labels translates the fixed words. error marks the control invalid (aria-invalid on what your control spreads it onto) and shows the message; Input and Select draw that themselves, while a control that frames itself on a wrapper, like NumberInput, needs has-[input[aria-invalid=true]]:border-destructive on its className.
